rules.description: Business must employ staff or use subcontractors (construction)
rules.reason_if_failed: You only need to register as an employer if you employ staff or use subcontractors for construction work

rules.description: Employees must earn above Lower Earnings Limit or receive expenses/benefits
rules.reason_if_failed: You only need to register if employees earn above the Lower Earnings Limit (£123/week for 2024-25) or receive expenses or benefits
You must register before your first payday. If you have already paid employees, contact HMRC for late registration guidance.

rules.description: Cannot register more than 2 months before starting to pay people
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot register more than 2 months before you start paying people. Please return closer to your first payday.

rules.description: Business must operate in the UK for HMRC PAYE purposes
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for UK-based employers. Contact HMRC for international employment arrangements.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is sole director of limited company
edge_cases.action: Confirm requirement: You must register even if you are the only director and only paying yourself.
Route to Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) registration in addition to PAYE. Additional verification required.
Hand off to HMRC helpline. Late full payment submission process required. Potential penalties may apply.

edge_cases.description: Employer of agricultural or horticultural workers
edge_cases.action: Advise on Agricultural Minimum Wage requirements and additional reporting obligations.
Route to Welsh language version of service (Cymraeg).
